title: Review a Dockerfile before it ships
heading: The Image Runs as a Non-Root User and Holds No Credentials
cases: a clean two-stage file has no findings, and a file breaking all four rules has all four
a base tagged latest is not pinned; a base pinned by sha256 digest is
the port in a registry host name is not mistaken for a tag
FROM scratch names Docker's empty image, which has no tag to pin, so it is not flagged
a USER in the build stage does not make the final stage non-root
USER 0 and USER root:root still run as root
a password among several ENV pairs, in lower case, is found
a lower-case shell-form entrypoint is a shell-form command
